info.title: gamer-network API
info.description: Conventions: docs/API.md. Every non-2xx response is an ErrorResponse.

PlayerStatus.description: Already reset to not_available once its time has passed.

customGameName.description: Set only for a custom game.

status.description: Already reset to not_available once its time has passed.

actor.description: Who caused it; for check_in_due, who you played with.

postId.description: The post it is about (post_gg, post_comment, comment_reply, mention, recruit_*).

recruitApplicationId.description: recruit_application and recruit_accepted: the application (its post is postId).

groupId.description: The group it is about (group_join_request, group_join_approved, group_event).

groupEventId.description: group_event: the event (its group is groupId).

text.description: Ready to show, e.g. "Hana wants to play PUBG Mobile with you".

route.description: In-app path to open on tap, same as the push's data.route.

ids.description: Ids to mark read. Or send all: true.

playedWith.description: Different people you checked in "played" with.

status.description: Already reset to not_available once its time has passed.

hasPassword.description: False for Google-only accounts, so Settings can offer "Set a password".

onboardedAt.description: Null until "Go live"; route to onboarding while null.

statusUntil.description: When available_tonight or playing clears itself.

gamingIds.description: Only the ones you may see.

incomingRequestId.description: Set when relationship is incoming_request, to accept from the profile.

outgoingRequestId.description: Set when relationship is outgoing_request, to withdraw from the profile.

token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Keep it in secure storage.

isNew.description: True when this call created the account: go to onboarding.

idToken.description: From Google Sign-In on the device, or Google Identity Services on the web.

username.description: Only for a new account: send after a 422 signup_details_required.

displayName.description: Defaults to the name on the Google account.

currentPassword.description: Required unless the account has no password yet (Google-only).

minSupportedVersion.description: Apps below this version must update (they get 426 everywhere else).

latestVersion.description: Newest released version, for a gentle "Update available".

launchCity.description: The one city the beta runs in.

groupsComingSoon.description: Show the Groups tab as "coming soon" with a waitlist. False once groups ship (the opposite of groupsEnabled).

feedEnabled.description: Show the Home feed (posts, comments, GG). On by default (FEED_ENABLED=false turns it off).

groupsEnabled.description: Show Groups for real. On by default (GROUPS_ENABLED=false turns it off).

id.description: Short id shared with the app's catalog, e.g. "val".

hasRanks.description: False when the ladder is play-style levels rather than ranks.

maxParty.description: Largest party a listing can ask for: 2 = Duo … 5 = 5-stack.

isLaunch.description: Launch games are the ones Find Players offers.

rankId.description: A rank of this game, from GET /v1/games. Catalog games only.

roleId.description: A role of this game. Catalog games only.

games.description: The full list, in profile order. Replaces what was there.

gameId.description: Required for in_game (e.g. a PUBG Mobile UID), absent otherwise.

gamingIds.description: The full list. Replaces what was there.

status.description: available_tonight clears at 04:00, playing after 4 hours.

availableDays.description: The MO–SU row. Left as is when absent.

gameId.description: The game for "Playing …" or "Looking …". Ignored for not_available.

size.description: The file's exact size in bytes, at most 2 MB. Resize on the phone first.

uploadUrl.description:
PUT the file here before `expiresAt`, with `headers`. The body must be
exactly the `size` you asked for (the URL is signed for it); let the
HTTP client set Content-Length.

key.description: Send to PUT /v1/me/avatar once the upload succeeds.
The key from POST /v1/me/avatar/upload-url, after the upload finished.

status.description: Already reset to not_available once its time has passed.

statusUntil.description: When available_tonight or playing clears itself.

gamingIds.description: Only the ones you may see.

incomingRequestId.description: Set when relationship is incoming_request, to accept from the profile.

outgoingRequestId.description: Set when relationship is outgoing_request, to withdraw from the profile.

ListingStatus.description: expired as soon as expiresAt passes, even before the expiry job runs.

status.description: expired as soon as expiresAt passes, even before the expiry job runs.

partySize.description: Whole party including the owner: 2 = Duo … 5 = 5-stack.

filled.description: Players accepted so far, owner not counted.

myRequest.description: Your latest request to join, for "Requested…" / "Connected ✓". Null on your own.

durationHours.description: How long it stays up once play starts.

rankId.description: The rank this group plays at. Defaults to your rank in this game.

partySize.description: Whole party including you, up to the game's maxParty.

lookingNow.description: Distinct people in your city with an open listing or a "looking" status.

playWhen.description: Moves the start and the end, keeping durationHours, counted from now.

listing.description: Your open or full listing, or null.

PostKind.description: Draw by this: follows from type.

MediaKind.description: Only image for now; video comes later.

kind.description: Only image for now; video comes later.

url.description: Signed when the bucket is private: use as given (ADR-0009).

posterUrl.description: A video's still frame; null for images.

width.description: Null when not known: size the image from the file.

position.description: 0–3, in the order the author wrote them.

myVote.description: The position you voted for, or null.

applications.description: How many applied, leaving out people hidden from you (blocked either way); the author sees the list.

parentId.description: The top-level comment this replies to, or null.

kind.description: Draw by this: follows from type.

author.description: topGame gives "Diamond Valorant" for the header.

topComment.description: Discussions: the most-GG'd answer. Null on other kinds.

commentCount.description: Comments and replies you can see the count of ("answers" on discussions).

PollDuration.description: How long it stays open: 1 day, 3 days or 1 week.

duration.description: How long it stays open: 1 day, 3 days or 1 week.

options.description: 2–4 options, 1–60 characters each, trimmed, all different.

roles.description: Free text, e.g. "Sniper, Support". Up to 80 characters, trimmed.

gameId.description: One of GET /v1/games. Null or left out: "Any game".

groupId.description: Post in this group instead of Home: members only (403 not_member). Group posts are for everyone in the group, so audience=connections is refused.

media.description: Up to 4 keys from POST /v1/media/upload-url, uploaded by you and not used yet. Required on gameplay.

poll.description: Required on poll posts, refused on others.

recruit.description: Required on recruitment posts, refused on others.

parentId.description: The comment you're replying to. A reply to a reply goes under the same top-level comment.

size.description: The file's exact size in bytes, at most 10 MB. Resize on the phone first (longest side 1600 px).

uploadUrl.description:
PUT the file here before `expiresAt`, with `headers`. The body must be
exactly the `size` you asked for (the URL is signed for it); let the
HTTP client set Content-Length.

key.description: Put it in POST /v1/posts `media` once the upload succeeds, before `expiresAt`.

media.description: The first image only, for the preview; empty when it has none.

listingId.description: When sent from a listing card: one of their live listings.

listing.description: Set when sent from a listing card ("wants to play · Div 2 EA FC 25").

GroupRole.description: Null when you aren't a member (or are still pending).

MembershipStatus.description: pending: you asked to join and wait for an admin. Null: not in it.

goingCount.description: People going, leaving out anyone no longer live.

goingPreview.description: Up to 3 of them, for the avatars.

createdBy.description: Its creator or a group admin can delete it.

myRole.description: Null when you aren't a member (or are still pending).

myStatus.description: pending: you asked to join and wait for an admin. Null: not in it.

short.description: The badge, e.g. "VAL": 2–5 uppercase letters or digits.

game.description: Set on game groups; may be set on others.

rules.description: Up to 10, up to 140 characters each.

approval.description: New members wait for an admin.

membersPreview.description: Up to 3 members, your connections first.

nextEvent.description: The soonest upcoming event, or null.

createdBy.description: Who created the group. Report the group with `userId = createdBy.id`.

name.description: 3–40 characters, trimmed. Unique, ignoring case (409 group_name_taken).

short.description: The badge: 2–5 letters or digits, stored uppercase. Left out: made from the name.

gameId.description: One of GET /v1/games. Required on game groups.

place.description: City, campus or country: 1–60 characters, trimmed.

rules.description: Up to 10 rules, 1–140 characters each, trimmed.

approval.description: New members wait for an admin. Default false.

name.description: 3–40 characters, trimmed. Unique, ignoring case (409 group_name_taken).

short.description: The badge: 2–5 letters or digits, stored uppercase. Left out: made from the name.

gameId.description: One of GET /v1/games. Required on game groups.

place.description: City, campus or country: 1–60 characters, trimmed.

rules.description: Up to 10 rules, 1–140 characters each, trimmed.

approval.description: New members wait for an admin. Default false.

gameId.description: One of GET /v1/games, or left out.

InviteStatus.description: expired as soon as expiresAt passes while pending.

status.description: expired as soon as expiresAt passes while pending.

expiresAt.description: Count down to this; unanswered by then, it is expired.

items.description: Pending and not expired, newest first.

game.description: The game of the listing or invite that led here.

items.description: People you blocked, most recent first (Settings → Blocked users).

listingId.description: When reporting from a listing card: one of their listings.

postId.description: When reporting a post: one of their posts.

commentId.description: When reporting a comment: one of their comments.

groupId.description: When reporting a group: one they created (userId is its creator).

password.description: Required when the account has a password (hasPassword on Me).

postsCount.description: Their live posts, on Home and in groups.

groupsCount.description: Live groups they're a member of.

excerpt.description: What was reported: the first 300 characters of the post or comment, or of the group's about.

ResolveAction.description: dismiss: no action. warn, remove_listing, remove_post, remove_comment, remove_group (the reported one), ban (the target).

action.description: dismiss: no action. warn, remove_listing, remove_post, remove_comment, remove_group (the reported one), ban (the target).

reason.description: Shown to nobody but admins; keep it factual.
